<job_seeker>
Fictional persona. MS, Information Systems, Northeastern University, completed 2025-12. One AI Engineer Co-op (2025-01 to 2025-08): Built a Genie Router Agent (Databricks Genie API + LangGraph) used by 120+ analysts, cutting SQL query time ~30%. Designed an inference pipeline with MLflow 3.0 tracing, drift monitoring, and performance dashboards. Built an A/B framework for LLM evaluation with significance testing across 5+ production experiments. Skills: AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, Kubeflow, LangGraph, MLflow, Mem0, Power BI, Python, Ray, SQL, Unity Catalog. Lives in Boston, MA.
</job_seeker>

<filter_rules>
These are the job seeker's written filter rules (FILTER.md v1.1). Use them as guidance for what she cares about; you still answer the same yes/no question.
- Role (title): AI engineer, machine learning engineer, ML engineer, LLM engineer are her core roles; software engineer, data engineer, analytics engineer, data scientist, research engineer are adjacent roles.
- Level (title): senior, sr, staff, principal, lead, manager, director, head, vp, chief, distinguished, architect, intern, internship are not for her.
- Topics that count (only in the role's own text, not company boilerplate): Python; SQL; LLMs / generative AI; agents / LangGraph; machine learning / MLflow; evaluation; Databricks / Delta Lake / Unity Catalog; AWS.
- Early-career phrases (new grad, entry level, early career, junior, recent/university graduate) are a strong plus.
- A stated requirement of 5+ years is a small minus, not a disqualifier.
</filter_rules>

 "description": "P-1592
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data and AI teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.
As part of the Unity AI Gateway team, you'll build the control plane that every AI request at Databricks passes through: partner and self-hosted models, agents, coding assistants, and MCP servers. It enforces budgets, routes each request to the right model, and applies guardrails inline. Unity AI Gateway is one of our fastest-growing businesses, moving trillions of tokens per week for thousands of customers.
The impact you will have:
Build the routing layer that picks the right model for each request across quality, cost, latency, availability, and remaining budget
Improve reliability, latency, and efficiency of distributed AI workloads
Collaborate with research, platform, infra, and AI/ML teams to deliver seamless end-to-end experiences
Shape how developers and data scientists build and interact with AI on Databricks
What we look for:
8+ years of experience in backend or infrastructure engineering
Strong programming skills in Scala, or Go
Experience with distributed systems, high-throughput APIs, or cloud-native infrastructure
Familiarity with service-oriented architecture, deployment pipelines, and system observability
Strong product and ownership mindset. You care about building the right solution, not just any solution
Bonus points for:
Experience with real-time serving, AI infrastructure, or GPU orchestration
Exposure to platforms like Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Azure ML
Experience building developer platforms or internal tools supporting AI workflows

Databricks is the Data and AI company.
